She now brings in her profound experience in Office and Event Management as well as Process Optimization. Ruth is talented in finding solutions and connected thinking. In her free time, Ruth is goalkeeper of her women’s soccer team and loves travelling. She is proud of her small house and lovingly arranged garden.

wp:markus-lang.title: Markus Lang
wp:markus-lang.text: Back to overview Current Portfolio Gustav Tripbakery Ivary byrd Atmosplay Shapr3D GoStudent GoFoxBox Habitalix pikd Gig.fm Refurbed Upvest Impala prewave Markus Lang Head of Pre-Seed Program From tech entrepreneur to venture capitalist – Markus knows many ways to engage in innovation and change. As Head of Speedinvest’s Pre-Seed Program, Markus supports outstanding founders of digital tech companies all across Europe. Markus has taken on several board roles in his portfolio startups, not hesitating to provide them with comprehensive support in every stage and situation they needed a hand – from finding a product-market-fit to successfully raising follow-on funding. Markus builds on his work as a project manager & consultant and his experience in co-founding a logistics tech startup as well as building and scaling several companies. He is passionate about his work and a steadfast and inspiring partner in crime.

wp:heinrich-groeller.title: Heinrich Gröller
wp:heinrich-groeller.text: Back to overview Heinrich Gröller Partner Heinrich has extensive hands-on know-how in company building, be it by starting and managing a greenfield project – in particular, a wooden pallet factory in the Czech Republic – or by leading the Austrian technology company Schiebel during the expansion phase – where together with a great team, he built two new factories, tripled the workforce and expanded the turnover from single digit to approximately 40m in less than three years. “What motivates me is sharing my ideas, contacts and experience – teaching and learning at the same time – on level-playing field with a motivated founder team. It is in the tough times every start-up has to face from time to time, when you see who is really your partner.” Heinrich holds a Master degree in Industrial Management and Manufacturing Engineering from ETH Zürich and expanded his multi-facetted technical know-how as a management consultant, startup founder, and managing director of various companies, by being inter alia responsible for Research and Development and Production. Heinrich has actively been investing in startups since 2014 with a focus on Industry and Proptech. His portfolio comprises nine startups and one successful exit so far. At Speedinvest i, Heinrich brings in his industry knowledge and contacts and is eager to accompany enthusiastic founder teams in complex and innovative projects.

wp:enrique-martinez-hausmann.title: Enrique Martínez-Hausmann
wp:enrique-martinez-hausmann.text: Back to overview Enrique Martínez-Hausmann Analyst Born and raised in Barcelona but having German roots, Enrique helps Speedinvest create and maintain a stronger relationship with Spain. After graduating from ESADE in Business Administration with a concentration in Finance, he gained experience in various startups in Berlin, where he became passionate about Business Development and Product Management. Previously, Enrique worked in EY’s Transaction Advisory Services department where he focused on major deals with financial institutions. There, he learned that well-functioning financial ecosystems are key to the betterment of any given society, which is why he is passionate about finding the most promising FinTech companies in Europe and assisting them in optimizing financial ecosystems, which ultimately aids both the communities and their inhabitants. Enrique carries his passion from work into his personal life; as a triple medalist in the Spanish national Track and Field championships for triple jump, he now pursues other athletic endeavors such as soccer and squash with friends, and as a Clarinetist, he explores his interest in music with an enthusiasm for classical and jazz music.

wp:dawid-rylski.title: Dawid Rylski
wp:dawid-rylski.text: Back to overview Dawid Rylski Analyst With a BSc in Finance and a MSc in Law from Kozminski University in Warsaw, Dawid unites his knowledge of the financial world with legal understanding. Following his growing interest in startups, he obtained a second Master’s degree in Management from London Business School with focus on entrepreneurship. Dawid studied and worked in four different countries and cities, comprising Warsaw, Madrid, London, and now Vienna. During his time in London, Dawid was given a chance to gain early-stage startup experience by working for Weengs, a seed-stage e-commerce fulfilment startup. Furthermore, Dawid dived into the world of Investment Banking at JP Morgan and M&A at PwC where he worked on buy-side and sell-side transactions in various industries, including technology as well as healthcare. At Speedinvest, Dawid is a part of the pre-seed team, where he is responsible for sourcing and evaluating investments. Being an avid sports enthusiast, Dawid not only pursues his interest via following games on the screen but also used to play football on a semi-professional level. Moreover, Dawid enjoys cycling as well as surfing in summer next to snowboarding in winter.

wp:dilek-topkan.title: Dilek Topkan
wp:dilek-topkan.text: Back to overview Dilek Topkan Controlling & Accounting Dilek loves to discover the diverse fields her passion lies. She completed her vocational training as an office administrator and gained further experience in the fields of retail, fashion and cosmetics. She also worked as a receptionist in a fitness center. Several administrative tasks brought her back to bookkeeping. Loving to keep track of things and work in a structured way, Dilek realized that this was what she wanted to do in the long run. “Trial and error are nothing to fear, they will show you the way. Never allow your weaknesses to make you lose faith in yourself. ” She started her professional training as a bookkeeper and gained first experiences at General Electric Austria GmbH. Dilek then was eager to dive into the world of startups and VC. Before joining Speedinvest, she took on a role as a bookkeeper at whatchado.

wp:galina-rachenkova.title: Galina Rachenkova
wp:galina-rachenkova.text: Back to overview Galina Rachenkova Associate Consultancy and industrial expertise united: Galina knows how to bring technology to a new level. Versatilely talented, Galina has joined Speedinvest from the Watson IoT Consulting Practice of IBM, where she focused on the Internet of Things, Cognitive Manufacturing, and Industry 4.0 fields. Priorly, she had gathered experience in consulting at J.D. Power and Associates GmbH, as well as in the automotive industry at Porsche and other OEMs. Galina graduated from Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT) with a M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering. She pursues an additional qualification as a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA). Galina’s versatile passion also comprises internationality and languages, vividly reflected in her fluent and broad English, German and Russian skills. At Speedinvest, Galina focuses on identifying the right Industry 4.0 investments, and actively deploys her industry and consulting know-how to support portfolio companies.

wp:pierre-francois-marteau.title: Pierre-Francois Marteau
wp:pierre-francois-marteau.text: Back to overview Current Portfolio Admix Maxfun Stowga Pierre-Francois Marteau Partner Pierre-Francois can look back at nearly twenty years of experience in digital media, both as an entrepreneur and as executive in a leading publishing group. He spent the last 17 years at Schibsted Media Group, mostly with a focus on digital marketplaces. Among other things, he has been CEO of La Centrale, the leading French motor vertical; board member of leboncoin, the leading French generalist marketplace from 2007 to 2015; and of SnT, a global JV with Telenor operating digital marketplaces in 12 emerging markets. He played a key role in defining Schibsted’s marketplace strategy, overseeing development in 26 markets worldwide, and pushing the development of mobile products as early as 2011. Pierre-Francois also has first-hand experience in news media, having launched 20 Minutes, the leading daily news publisher in France (11m certified readers) where he served as COO and ultimately as chairman of the board. He has been co-founder of five companies in the media, medical, sports & leisure industries.

wp:frederik-hagenauer.title: Frederik Hagenauer
wp:frederik-hagenauer.text: Back to overview Frederik Hagenauer Associate Frederik is a former founder and venture builder with a profound interest in technology. In 2012 he founded Skive, a digital learning platform trusted by over 250,000 students across Europe, where he led operations and the growth function. Skive was sold to a competitor in late 2016 and Frederik subsequently worked in corporate venturing and company building. As an external expert for Digital McKinsey he helped set up an insurtech corporate venture. As an Entrepreneur in Residence at Entrepreneur First in London he acted as a sparring partner for incoming founders to help them build globally important deep tech companies. At Speedinvest, Frederik wants to combine these experiences. He is part of the pre-seed team where he aims to support the world’s most ambitious founders early on in their journey of creating world-changing companies. Frederik studied in Maastricht and Singapore and holds an Msc in International Political Economy from the London School of Economics. Aside from his work he is interested in the societal impact of technology. In 2017 Frederik helped launch Juan Mata’s football-based charity Common Goal in an effort to generate funds to contribute to the UN sustainable development goals.

wp:mirjana-dakic.title: Mirjana Dakic
wp:mirjana-dakic.text: Back to overview Mirjana Dakic Investment Controlling After accomplishing her BSc at Vienna University of Economics and Business with a specialisation in Accounting and Finance, Mirjana followed her passion. She started a Master’s program focussing on national and international accounting and regulatory standards. Eager to enrich her theoretical knowledge with practical experience, Mirjana then started working at KPMG Austria, where she gained valuable professional experience in teamwork and leadership. Mirjana performed financial audits according to national- and international regulations, such as UGB, IFRS and US-GAAP. Her experience, detail-driven attitude, curiosity, and analytical thinking led Mirjana to Speedinvest, where she eagerly took on the challenges of VC accounting and reporting. Outside of work, Mirjana enjoys hiking in the mountains and traveling. As a self-reliant and practical person, every now and then, she is keen to sew her own clothes. Mirjana is currently completing her Master’s thesis and is passionate about the future.

wp:magda-poluszny.title: Magda Posluszny
wp:magda-poluszny.text: Back to overview Current Portfolio Epilove Magda Posluszny Associate As a passionate founder and operator, Magda has started her first own company at the age of 19 – language schools in Poland, which were successfully acquired in 2016. With a BSc in Logistics, a BA in Linguistics (German and Swedish), and MSc in Economics, Magda achieved a profound interdisciplinary skillset. She founded the VC-backed startup Flyhacks.com, and together with an ambitious team successfully scaled the company into 12 European markets. Prior to joining Speedinvest, Magda formed part of the investment team at Seedrs, Europe’s leading online investment platform for early-stage and growth equity. Outside of work, Magda is an avid skier, reader and a pilates junkie. She is based in our London office in Victoria.

wp:krishan-allen.title: Krishan Allen
wp:krishan-allen.text: Back to overview Krishan Allen Analyst Krishan looks for the next wave of platforms and marketplaces set to transform lives and habits of people globally. He enjoys working with founders early on in their company’s journey, and helping teams climb their way to meaningful impact. He previously spent time investing with ICONIQ Capital, a global multi-family office serving influential individuals and organizations. Earlier in his career he founded, raised, and managed a microfund dedicated to socially responsible investments in public equities. Krishan’s work experience also includes stints in central banking, economic consulting, and social enterprise incubation. He completed his undergraduate studies at Santa Clara University (magna cum laude) and his MSc in Economics and Business at Erasmus University Rotterdam. Krishan grew up in California, and has lived in Singapore, Barcelona, the Netherlands, and now Berlin. He likes to spend his time traveling and meeting new people, reading novels for inspiration, playing basketball for perspiration, and sailing in the San Francisco Bay when at home. He has a soft spot for athletic sneakers from the 90’s, George Saunders’ short stories, and Californian pistachios.

wp:tara-schoeller-burke.title: Tara Schöller-Burke
wp:tara-schoeller-burke.text: Back to overview Tara Schöller-Burke Legal Counsel Tara is a real cosmopolitan. She was born in Austria, grew up in Ireland and after a year of travelling the world with her family as a 12-year-old, moved to New Zealand. Tara completed a Bachelor of Laws and a Bachelor of Arts majoring in International Relations at Victoria University, Wellington. After graduating, her interest in global affairs led her to intern at the European Parliament in the Directorate General for External Affairs. Tara returned to New Zealand in 2016 to start her career as a lawyer at a large national law firm. There, she specialised in corporate and commercial law with a particular focus on capital markets, business sales and acquisitions, as well as corporate structuring and governance. Tara advised a range of domestic and international clients and gained experience dealing with New Zealand market regulators, such as the Takeovers Panel, Financial Markets Authority and the New Zealand Stock Exchange. She was involved in a substantial number of private and public capital raisings, employee share purchase schemes, share purchase plans and stock exchange listings. Recently, Tara returned to Vienna and is excited to work with and apply her skills and experience to Europe’s thriving startup community. Outside of work, she loves to travel to warmer locations, discover new bands and explore local cafes and restaurants.

wp:mirjam-techt.title: Mirjam Techt
wp:mirjam-techt.text: Back to overview Current Portfolio MyClubs Mirjam Techt Associate Partner As a passionate product leader with more than nine years of senior experience in building successful marketplace products, Mirjam knows how to operate in interwoven and strong networks that shape the world of tomorrow. At Willhaben, Mirjam eagerly formed part of the whole journey: joining as the first product manager, she paved the company’s way up to number one across platforms and verticals. In her last role, Mirjam held responsibility for products across 12 Schibsted Marketplaces, including Italy, Hungary, Austria, Ireland, Morocco, as well as Mexico and Colombia. Mirjam enjoys working with inspirational teams of product managers and UX professionals, striving to create addictive user experiences and marketplace success. What inspires her is to guide others on their journey to become outstanding at what they do. “Among my ultimate goals lies the ambition to create and grow unique products that further increase user value every day – empowering users and customers to take smarter decisions, and improve their lives. ” Curious and constantly striving to learn more, Mirjam enjoys working in cross-functional teams and networks, and has an eye for the sweet spot where user excitement and business targets align. It excites her to see new products become addictive and ever more useful. In her freetime, it is the outdoors world that captivates her spirit. She is likely to be spotted up the hills, hiking or skiing, or on her bike cruising the city and country. Having studied in and conquered Australia, Mirjam gathered further international work impressions in charming Barcelona, which made her keen to polish up her Spanish skills.

wp:tom-lesche.title: Tom F. Lesche
wp:tom-lesche.text: Back to overview Tom F. Lesche Principal When Tom was co-founding a banking startup in Berlin, he realised first-hand how crucial it is to receive external financial and operational support early on. This experience keeps motivating him every day in his search for great founders and great ideas out there waiting for their success. As an investor, he is passionate about growth-stage companies and tech-enabled business models within the financial services industry, spanning from banking and insurance to asset management and specialty finance. Although always focused on the founders, Tom doesn’t mind the number crunching part where he can leverage his experience from many years in investment banking before joining Speedinvest Fintech. Most recently, he was a Vice President at Morgan Stanley in London, advising financial technology clients on a variety of capital markets and M&A transactions. Also at the academic level, he is curious about everything related to the financial sector. At Witten/Herdecke University, Tom studied in the fields of economics, banking and finance up to the PhD level and also gained some teaching experience at WHU, Kellogg and Goethe University. Raised in Hamburg, Tom enjoys his free time with boxing, running, and traveling to as many new and faraway places as possible.

wp:mathias-klozenbuecher.title: Mathias Klozenbücher
wp:mathias-klozenbuecher.text: Back to overview Mathias Klozenbücher Head of M&A and Business Development In 2006 Mathias moved to Los Angeles California basically overnight. An opportunity to finish his Master in Genetics and Microbiology at UCLA presented itself and Mathias gladly accepted. Who knew he would stay in the US for a total of 13 years. After finishing his Master’s degree and working in cancer research for 3 years he was hired by Siemens Healthcare. His diverse experience and expertise culminated in him leading Strategy, Business Development and Strategic Sourcing for the Molecular Diagnostic BU of Siemens, a highly innovative field of genetic testing. Whilst in this role, he defined a multi-billion Euro M&A strategy for the struggling business unit, but going through the long corporate approval process his targets were acquired by a competitor. “Helping startups grow is my focus. Healthtech is my passion. Throughout my career I have been convinced it will revolutionize healthcare and will help us to live longer and healthier.” Frustrated by slow decision making in the corporate sector Mathias jumped into the startup world. He joined the series B funded Silicon Valley Startup Fabric Genomics as part of their management team. Trying to prove that he could execute operationally and fascinated by the emerging Medtech of Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) he led the commercial efforts at Fabric. Mathias and his team transitioned the company into a commercially successful operation, doubling their revenue in less than a year. Other notable engagements included Palantir and Inventages Venture Capital. After taking a sabbatical and travelling the world kitesurfing for a year Mathias moved back to Austria and joined Speedinvest as our new Head of M&A and Business Development. In this free time, Mathias enjoys traveling, kitesurfing, skiing and filmmaking.

wp:alexandra-henegar.title: Alexandra Henegar
wp:alexandra-henegar.text: Back to overview Alexandra Henegar Front Desk Manager 27-year-old Alexandra Miriam grew up in Wels, Upper Austria. Her Romanian roots and unlimited passion for internationality motivated her to study International Relations and Education Studies. Alexandra Miriam gained vivid experience in working with children. Prior to joining Speedinvest, she worked as an ambitious school and kindergarten teacher. In her current position, Alexandra Miriam significantly benefits from the unique attitude and discipline she developed in this field, as she is highly goal-oriented and all eyes and ears for the people around her, whom she thoroughly supports. “Life is a succession of lessons which must be lived to be understood.” Ralph Waldo Emerson She strongly cares about their wellbeing and is keen to make sure that everybody walking through the doors of the Speedinvest Office feels welcome and at home. Organisational success matters a lot to Alexandra Miriam, who has a passion for structure and loves taking on great responsibilities. In her free time, she enjoys cooking, singing and swimming. Children and animals have conquered her heart.

wp:andreas-karl-weber.title: Andreas Carl Weber
wp:andreas-karl-weber.text: Back to overview Andreas Carl Weber Associate Based in the Vienna office, Andreas (nicknamed Carli) is an associate in the industrial tech team. Having a strong passion for science, in particular math and chemistry, he completed a bachelor’s and master’s degree in material science at the University of Leoben, a globally leading research institute. A broad interest in business and economics then led to the decision to complete a second bachelor’s degree in finance at the Vienna University of Economics. Carli graduated summa cum laude at the 98th percentile of his class. He also spent significant time at the University of Southern California, leading to a growth-hacking project at Skurt (a mobility-tech startup, funded by Upfront Ventures and later acquired by Fair); and to an extended research project in industrial machine learning, funded by the Austrian Marshall Plan Foundation. Prior to joining Speedinvest, Carli conducted consulting projects for Voestalpine, in particular in the area of predictive maintenance, technology management and additive manufacturing. He has also worked in the strategic advisory team of a global board member of the Volkswagen Group, concentrating on mobility tech and industry 4.0. Outside of the office, Carli fosters his life-long passion for music (playing drums and percussion). Other hobbies include meeting friends (ideally for coffee or international cuisine), fitness, reading and everything related to nature. He is a regular skier and enjoys travelling to explore new landscapes (and cultures). Carli has lived in multiple countries and speaks Spanish, English and German.

wp:namratha-kothapalli.title: Namratha Kothapalli
wp:namratha-kothapalli.text: Back to overview Namratha Kothapalli Senior Associate Being part of Speedinvest’s Deeptech team, Namratha focuses on businesses within the fields of enterprise software, data and cloud stacks. She joined Speedinvest as a senior associate after completing her MBA at London Business School in 2019. Namratha is a software engineer by background, specializing in memory and storage technologies. She is keen to build on her experience as an engineer as well as on her business education to support founders in bringing innovation to the market. Prior to this she was a software engineer having worked across the stack at Intel, HP and Dell-EMC. During the MBA, she worked at Passion Capital conducting duediligence and managing the deal flow. She also worked as a Growth Product Manager at HomeAway, where she helped develop a visitor segmentation machine learning model to optimize ad spend. In addition to the MBA, she holds a Master’s degree in Computer Science from Clemson University, US, and a Bachelor’s degree in Electronics from Osmania University, India. In her spare time, she enjoys reading, being outdoors, traveling the world, and is currently learning German. If you knew her better, you’d find she dreams of retiring as a part-time mountain guide. The Aconcagua, Kilimanjaro and Everest Base Camp reflect where she feels alive: Namratha travelled to more than 40 countries and has visited most national parks in the US.

wp:felix-fein.title: Felix Fein
wp:felix-fein.text: Back to overview Felix Fein Associate To Felix, supporting founders on their path to accomplishing great ideas is one of his highest premises. Felix completed an MSc in Strategy, Innovation and Management Control (SIMC) from Vienna University of Economics and Business with an exchange semester at Chicago Booth. He previously gained experience in strategy consulting and the corporate environment. Soon he found himself most committed to supporting founders in the one area that, from his point of view, matters most: early stage investing. Enthusiastic about the future and how mankind will solve the major problems entangled in it, Felix wrote his master thesis on “The Future of Meat” – hence, the consumer acceptance of cultured meat. Felix is curious about authentic founders that are passionate about their business and joined Speedinvest because he wants to enable founders to reach their full potential. Felix also gained professional experience at strategy consulting firm Strategy&, early-stage investor Project A Ventures, i5invest and oil & gas company OMV. In his free time, Felix adores the mountains, lakes and seas around the world. During summer, he enjoys hiking and sailing, while in the winter you can find him on skis or a snowboard. Felix is currently training to complete his first triathlon. Always trying to make the most of every single day, he is passionate about travelling and meeting exceptional people to constantly learn from.

wp:cara-van-riet.title: Cara van Riet
wp:cara-van-riet.text: Back to overview Cara van Riet Operations Manager Cara’s love for travel and continual desire to learn about other cultures has motivated her to live and work all over the world including the US, London and Amsterdam. Passionate about sustainability and efficiency, she approaches problem solving with creativity and clear communication. An avid film photographer, Cara is always interested in how others see the world; a curiosity which pushes her to constantly try and see things from different perspectives. Originally from Cape Town, South Africa, she now calls Berlin her home. While studying for a business degree, Cara discovered her creative passion, leading her to pursue studies in Fine Art. After graduating, she found the perfect company that allowed her to work with artists whilst honing her business skills. Having joined the company before a vital and exponential growth phase, this opportunity afforded her hands-on experience in Business and Product Development, Brand Management and Operations. For more than 8,5 years, her contribution was one of the main drivers behind the achievements of key KPIs and the successful overhaul of failing business modules. This experience in scaling places Cara at the heart of Speedinvest’s mission to help start-ups navigate this same journey.

wp:niklas-fip.title: Niklas Fip
wp:niklas-fip.text: Back to overview Niklas Fip Analyst Niklas joined Speedinvest Industry in December 2018 and is based in our Vienna office. Born in an industrial suburb of the Ruhr Valley, a highly urbanized region in Germany, Niklas inevitably encountered the old economy very early. Having developed a strong passion for technologies, he first gained professional experience in the energy industry, from gas extraction projects in Russia to commodity trading in Switzerland, and later gained insights in the agile environment of an early-stage startup in Vienna. Torn between the startup ecosystem and the industrial world, he graduated in Finance & Entrepreneurship from WU Wien, where he also conducted research on investment decisions, and later decided to do his masters in Industrial Engineering and Management. Outside the office, Niklas loves to meet new people, is fascinated by history and astronomy and as a former handball player, enjoys all kind of team-sports. Passionate about piano and guitar, he enjoys composing songs and listening to all-kind of music.

wp:tengiz-tkeshelashvili.title: Tengiz Tkeshelashvili
wp:tengiz-tkeshelashvili.text: Back to overview Tengiz Tkeshelashvili Representative Qatar & Middle East Proactive, target-driven Tengiz holds over twenty years of experience in banking, private equity, consulting and entrepreneurship. Prior to joining Speedinvest, he worked as a Venture Capital Investments Head for QBD Doha, Qatar, where he sourced, analyzed and executed venture capital deals and developed the company’s asset allocation strategy. In his past, Tengiz had worked as a Manager for Investments and Active Asset Manager for the EuropeBet Venture Fund in London as well as for Groupon Ukraine. Tengiz holds an MBA from INSEAD France & Singapore and a master’s degree in Economics from the Professional Academy of Mosbach, Germany. His banking background has roots in consulting and his work as Deputy CEO and Director of Reorganizations and Special Projects (after other previous positions) at TBC Bank Tbilisi in Georgia. Besides managing the troubled assets portfolio of the bank, Tengiz acted as Interim Manager for a number of companies and led an essential reorganization case in the region. At McKinsey Frankfurt, he had led projects across the Middle East and North Africa, including a merger of Emirates NBD and Dubai Bank. His broad horizon and vast experience are also reflected in his language skills: apart from his Georgian mother tongue, Tengiz speaks five languages, including Russian, German and a bit of French and Arabic. Tengiz loves spending time in nature to go hiking, biking, fishing, and hunting. He is a big fan of political-economic debates, where he brings in his vast knowledge in the field.

wp:jeremy-crider.title: Jeremy Crider
wp:jeremy-crider.text: Back to overview Jeremy Crider Head of Communications & Product From the small town of Broadway, Virginia, to the busy streets of Beijing and Berlin, Jeremy’s diverse career in communications has taken him around the world. ​ As a television news presenter and producer, Jeremy conducted exclusive interviews with victims of the 2007 Virginia Tech shooting massacre as part of WSLS TV’s Peabody award-winning news coverage and assisted China’s Xinhua News Agency with the launch of its first-ever, global English-language television news network as a Senior Foreign Expert and Executive Producer. ​ “Every person and every business has a one-of-a-kind story to tell. My passion is uncovering those stories and sharing them with the world. ” In 2014, Jeremy shifted gears and began helping companies share their unique stories with target audiences. While Head of U.S. Consumer Communications for Trivago, Jeremy and his team successfully turned the German startup and its spokesperson, The Trivago Guy, into household names in North America. And people from Berlin to Barcelona now ‘Sweat Smarter Together’ thanks to the brand identity and communications strategy he developed for fitness startup BEAT81.​ When Jeremy isn’t busy ensuring Speedinvest is known globally as Europe’s most unique, innovative and Founder-focused seed fund, you’ll find him travelling, working out and completing DIY projects at his home in Berlin. ​

wp:yang-tran.title: Yang Tran
wp:yang-tran.text: Back to overview Yang Tran Analyst At Speedinvest, Yang is part of the General Seed team, and is responsible for sourcing and evaluating investments. He previously worked at Silicon Valley-based VC Plug and Play Ventures as a Ventures Analyst and prior to that, he worked at a Dutch Hedgefund in Amsterdam as a Research Analyst. Yang also dived into banking with internships at Berenberg and UBS. He holds two master’s degrees from the Rotterdam School of Management (Erasmus University). For his master’s thesis in Business Information Management, he focused on predicting bitcoin price movements using machine learning techniques. In his second master’s program, Finance & Investments, Yang wrote about ownership, underpricing and the long-term performance of US Internet IPOs. Engaging in a variety of fields, he founded a student investment fund. Machine learning not only captures Yang’s interest in the business context: he also enjoys to code in his free time and cultivates a passion for automating things. Yang is also a great traveler who loves exploring new cultures. He has been on a number of road cycling trips through the Netherlands. His next trip is planned to be from Berlin to Copenhagen.

wp:rukiye-vural.title: Rukiye Vural
wp:rukiye-vural.text: Back to overview Rukiye Vural Trainee Tax Consultant Law inspired Rukiye in a particular way since she was a child. This fascination led her to the University of Vienna to study Law. During her studies she worked at Jungbauer and Moderinsky as Head of the Legal Department and also supported the Marketing team. She decided to gain more experience in legal matters and did some post-study internships at the District Court Inner City of Vienna and the Public Prosecution in WienerNeustadt. While studying Law Rukiye developed a special passion for tax law. A master’s degree in Finance and Accounting was the next step. “Never lose sight of your goals ” Now, working at the finance department of Speedinvest, Rukiye supports the team not only with her legal knowledge but also with her love for numbers and structure. Rukiye is planning on doing the examination as a tax consultant, which is a great opportunity to live her sense of justice. Baking pastries is the perfect way to unfold and develop her creativity and music is the perfect company for this purpose. In her free time Rukiye not only loves to heat the oven, but also enjoys the nature while taking walks and travel to sunny destinations.

wp:oliver-holle-speedinvest-ceo.title: Oliver Holle
wp:oliver-holle-speedinvest-ceo.text: Back to overview Current Portfolio Datapath Investly Wikifolio Oliver Holle Managing Partner, CEO In 1997, long before European pioneers were familiar with terms like mobile, entrepreneur or startup, Oliver switched paths – at that time he was working on his PhD thesis in Economics at Columbia University – to launch his first tech startup. After raising way too much money and spending it all in the first tech bubble of the early 2000’s, Oliver and his team battled for three long years against insolvency, finally emerging with a successful pivot into mobile data. In order to accelerate growth, Oliver merged his company with two other startups into 3united AG to become a highly profitable European leader in mobile content and messaging. The acquisition of 3united by Verisign was not only one of the biggest exits coming from Austria at that time but also took Oliver to Silicon Valley, where he spent two years with one of the most ambitious US-based tech companies of the era. “As a founder, I have been challenged, laughed at, celebrated and plainly ignored. As an investor, I try to be helpful, honest and always – always – respect the founder.” The experience convinced Oliver that European founders can also win big in the Valley and beyond. He returned to Austria determined to build a new type of venture fund, defined by his strong belief that seed-stage venture requires a very different model than he had experienced. Despite warnings from pretty much everyone he knew, Oliver and his scrappy founder team went on to develop their very unique venture model and, in 2011, eventually raised a tiny micro fund of €10M – Speedinvest was born. Today, Oliver contributes in various capacities across the company, which is now recognized as one of the leading seed stage venture capital firms in Europe.

wp:marie-helene-ametsreiter-partner-indu.title: Marie-Helene Ametsreiter
wp:marie-helene-ametsreiter-partner-indu.text: Back to overview Current Portfolio Greetzly Gronda Wegfinder Aircloak Amodo Marie-Helene Ametsreiter Partner In the course of her numerous marketing and general management positions in Western and South-Eastern Europe, telecommunication industry expert Marie Helene has gained sound experience in the telecom industry. As Head of International Market Affairs and Head of Strategic Market Planning and Research at Mobilkom Austria, she took on great responsibilities and developed a profound understanding of the telecom environment. “I’m bored by routines, excited by new challenges. Working at Speedinvest is a great deal – it gives me the opportunity to work with YOU, joining forces to speed up success.” Marie Helene gained further hands-on experience taking over Sales and Marketing for VIPnet, Croatia’s first private mobile phone network. Her outstanding performance made her become VIPnet CEO and President of the Board – positions she held for over 3 years. In March 2011, Marie Helene’s next challenge was leading OMV AG’s Corporate Sustainability Department, one of Austria’s largest listed industrial companies. Since 2014, we are proud to have her at Speedinvest as a Partner. Marie-Helene is heading Speedinvest´s office in Munich and focusing on Industry 4.0 investments.

wp:daniel-keiper-knorr-speedinvest-partn.title: Daniel Keiper-Knorr
wp:daniel-keiper-knorr-speedinvest-partn.text: Back to overview Current Portfolio Storyclash Enbrite.ly Daniel Keiper-Knorr Partner From ski instructor and stock broker to startup founder and investor: creating new things and guiding others to excellence runs like a golden thread through his life. ‘New millenium, new enterprise’ thought Daniel, who founded his first company in 2000 . Shortly thereafter, i n 2004, he co-founded 3united, a 3-way merger, which, in early 2006, was acquired by VeriSign for EUR 55m. “Creating things and partnering with beginners to guide them to excellence runs like a golden thread through my life – in business as in private.” From 2007 onwards, Daniel continued to flap his wings a s a business angel and consultant. He invested in five Austrian and Swiss startups. Ambitious as he is, in 2011, he co-founded Speedinvest. As a Partner, Daniel runs investor relations and the fundraising desk and supports portfolio companies with business development. Thanks to Daniel’s great thirst for actio n and outstanding communication skills, Speedinvest has established a broad and versatile network across Europe. Daniel is a passionate skier.

wp:michael-schuster-managing-partner-spe.title: Michael Schuster
wp:michael-schuster-managing-partner-spe.text: Back to overview Current Portfolio Bitmovin Candis ClauseMatch Dronamics Finnest Flaviar Metrilo Tourradar Tripmakery Usersnap Michael Schuster Managing Partner, CIO Michael enjoys when ideas come alive, develop and grow. As Speedinvest Co-founder and Partner, he always believed that helping entrepreneurs make their dreams come true is the “dent” that investors can make in the universe. For a decade, Michael worked in the IT industry, riding the startup rollercoaster on a daily basis. Building enterprise software and media startups, ranging from semantic technologies for collaboration to social media monitoring, left a lasting impression. “Good teams are like a band: together they sound better and when you are on stage, it feels like magic. Working to get the best “sound” possible and creating meaningful music is a wonderful experience. ” Michael worked on the next generation of online banking and built the first commercial bloghoster in Europe. His background in Computer Science and Economics and Business Administration enables him to work effectively with startup teams and founders to get their product ready for prime time, address customers early in the life cycle and build outstanding teams.

wp:gunita-bhasin.title: Gunita Bhasin
wp:gunita-bhasin.text: Back to overview Gunita Bhasin Analyst Gunita is a former banker, entrepreneur, and public speaker who is passionate about everything to do with technology and startups. Prior to joining the investment team at Speedinvest, Gunita worked at Atomico and Deutsche Bank, where she founded Showcased, a B2C platform that helps people pursue their passions. She has given a number of speeches about doing what you love, including a TEDx talk entitled ‘How You Make a Difference’. “One of the most exciting aspects of working in tech is that what you are doing has a real impact on people. I like to seek out the positive impact that founders have on the societies they operate in.” Gunita holds an MSc in Economics for Development from Oxford, where she was as a Sloane Robinson Scholar, and a BSc in Economics from Warwick, where she graduated with a first class honours. Even back in the day, Gunita chose to write her masters thesis on technology for development and her undergraduate dissertation on what causes SMEs to go viral. Outside of work, Gunita is a big fan of food, travel and exercise. She is a certified PADI open water diver and lived in four different countries (UK, Turkey, Singapore and India) before she turned 13.

wp:timothy-krause.title: Timothy Krause
wp:timothy-krause.text: Back to overview Timothy Krause Analyst Timothy, an analytical thinker and cosmopolitan, found his passion in data analysis, team collaboration, writing, and teaching. He holds a Master’s degree in Biological Sciences with a specialization in Genetics, Cell and Molecular Biology from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln. As a research assistant, he discovered new genetic trends in microbes. Timothy had also conducted research for the National Science Foundation in Lincoln, where he had analysed the genetic composition of bacteria using computational biology software. Besides genetics and coding, Timothy has lived a passion for teaching. During his Bachelor’s degree at Bethany Lutheran College in Mankato, Minnesota, he had already tutored students in German. At the Austrian Federal Ministry of Education, Science and Research, Timothy lectured on a range of scientific, historical, and cultural topics, coordinated lecture schedules among departments, and designed English learning exercises. In his free time, Timothy enjoys skiing, running, and biking. As a keyboardist himself, he is a big fan of baroque music, especially the compositions of J.S. Bach.

wp:bernhard-grabner.title: Bernhard Grabner
wp:bernhard-grabner.text: Back to overview Bernhard Grabner Head of Digital Strategy Starting his career in London with OMD International, Bernhard managed to accrue more than 9 years of agency experience by now. Having worked with major network agencies such as Dentsu Aegis Network he gathered experience as Digital Media Consultant of major national & international brands such as Verbund, IKEA, Microsoft. From pan-european campaigns to B2B Content Marketing he managed to develop a broad portfolio of skills in the Digital Media space, always with a focus on strategic edge and creative vision.

wp:kristyna-katona.title: Kristyna Katona
wp:kristyna-katona.text: Back to overview Kristyna Katona HR Research Kristyna joined Speedinvest in mid-October 2019. Always eager to learn she worked in different positions while studying, broadening her horizon and trying to figure out her true passion. On her journey she discovered HR & Recruiting for herself. Prior to joining Speedinvest, she worked as a recruiter in a fundraising agency, managing a team of three people. While gaining valuable work experience she is finishing her bachelor’s degree in Communications. In her free time Kristyna enjoys going to the gym, meditation, doing illustrations & designs as well as adding to her extensive book collection.

wp:thomas-rosenmayr.title: Thomas Rosenmayr
wp:thomas-rosenmayr.text: Back to overview Thomas Rosenmayr Managing B2B Sales Specialist Thomas loves building outstanding companies. His strong believe in the power of entrepreneurial spirit leads his professional life since the 1990s. Driven by his hands-on approach he seeks challenges and gets inspired by working with the best. At home he relaxes with a good glass of wine while cooking or having a disruptive discussion. Successful founders team up with the best to create outstanding companies. Willing is not enough, let’s do. Before joining Speedinvest, Thomas founded nexxar, a European leader in digital corporate reporting (50+ employees). He is a leading digital corporate communications expert in Europe with 20+ years of experience in large scale digital publishing projects with big corporates clients (eg. BASF, Barclays, Novartis, Shell, VW). He successfully built an international client base of +70 clients across Europe, North America and even Japan; a network he regularly taps into for the startups he works with.

wp:charlotte-paech.title: Charlotte Paech
wp:charlotte-paech.text: Back to overview Charlotte Paech Senior HR Consultant Heroes don’t need capes or spider bites. It’s the combination of head, heart and attitude that unleashes super powers. As a Senior HR Consultant, Charlotte has a trained eye for heroes and a gifted ability to transform them into teams as powerful as the Avengers. Charlotte has a decade of experience in Human Resources (HR). As a fast learner and high achiever, she has supported demanding clients across a wide range of industries and at varying different stages of development. By combining her academic background in HR with a hands-on attitude she has developed a rich set of methods to support start-ups, founders and new team members on a personal level. Here is how Charlotte can help: Matching the right people is like solving a puzzle. The edges (skills) need to be appreciated in order for each piece (talent) to fit the gaps (road blocks) in the larger picture (start-ups). During her professional experience Charlotte has found many missing pieces – under the sofa, during stealth mode, in the valley, across the pond, before beta – you name it. Running a start-up is tough. It takes blood, sweat and luck to get it right. But many teams fail under stress when they don’t treat their start-up as a living organism. Charlotte knows how to get through all the code and business lingo to identify your personal kryptonite. Charlotte is light-hearted and empathetic; in negotiations determined but fair. She gets excited by the spirit of the teams she mentors and is thankful for the positive change she can achieve with her work. Charlotte loves good food, which is somewhat surprising considering her cooking skills; she’d rather break her fingernails boxing than wrestling in the kitchen.

wp:janine-tricoire.title: Janine Tricoire
wp:janine-tricoire.text: Back to overview Janine Tricoire Brand Strategist After 2 years of profound corporate experience in marketing at Geberit and a MSc degree from WU Vienna, Janine joined Speedinvest in October 2019. Her open-minded personality and analytical skill-set enable her to quickly grasp diverse problem statements and elaborate new marketing strategies with a high level of determination and commitment.

wp:valerie-wiederkehr-prundianu.title: Valerie Wiederkehr-Prundianu
wp:valerie-wiederkehr-prundianu.text: Back to overview Valerie Wiederkehr-Prundianu HR Consultant Before joining Speedinvest in March 2019, Valerie started a fashion startup and worked as an HR Manager at Shpock. She’s a “people person”, who loves connecting the best talents with startups. In her pre-startup days, Valerie studied psychology and later HR in London.

wp:gabriela-gronychova.title: Gabriela Gronychova
wp:gabriela-gronychova.text: Back to overview Gabriela Gronychova HR Consultant Gabriela, as an HR Consultant, supports start-ups in their everyday recruiting activities. She is an enthusiastic young professional with experience not just in recruitment but also in employer branding and social media communication. Therefore she can benefit from her prior experience when building a strong online brand for our portfolio companies. Studying Business Administration and Human Resources at the University of Economics in Prague was the first important step she took towards developing her future in HR. During and after her studies, Gabriela worked for various international companies, where she was gathering HR experience and revealing different HR fields. As Gabriela believes that creative life is happy life, she devotes her free time to painting and other creative activities.

wp:mitchell-bradley.title: Mitchell Bradley
wp:mitchell-bradley.text: Back to overview Mitchell Bradley Senior Growth Strategist A rare breed, who is most comfortable when sitting at the intersection of marketing, sales and product with specialisations in product-led growth and automation. Mitchell joined Speedinvest in September 2019 having previously worked and consulted startups such as Mostly AI, Receipt Bank and Turnitin.

wp:jennifer-roth.title: Jennifer Roth
wp:jennifer-roth.text: Back to overview Jennifer Roth Senior HR Consultant Working as a Senior HR Consultant, Jennifer’s primary tasks involve supporting startups with recruiting by finding suitable team members and advising them about any process related questions. Jennifer describes herself as a very open, communicative and curious person who enjoys exploring the unknown and facing any challenges that come with the territory. For this reason, it has always been clear that she wants to work with people to be inspired by their individuality and diversity. Studying Psychology was the first important step she took towards developing her future in this direction. In her Master’s studies, she focused on work- and organizational Psychology and subsequently entered the field of HR. In order to achieve a holistic picture of HR Management during her studies, Jennifer worked for various national and international companies offering services for Compensation and Benefits, Human Resources Development, Recruiting and Executive Search. It was in cooperation with Roland Wadl (QMC), one of the managing partners, which finally enabled her to enter the startup world and brought her to Speedinvest. Setting up this new HR Company has been an incredible experience for Jennifer. From the start, it has been an absolute pleasure for her to be a part of the founding team and build a unique company that focuses exclusively on the needs of startups. Jennifer says: “Working with startups has given me an entirely new perspective. I am inspired daily by the huge amounts of creativity and commitment involved. At Speedinvest, we want to help startups find the best possible employees so founders are relieved of this task and can focus on other key aspects of growing their companies.” As a Psychologist, it is in Jennifer’s nature to want to work with and get to know different people and to recognize and promote their potential.

wp:lukas-rippitsch.title: Lukas Rippitsch
wp:lukas-rippitsch.text: Back to overview Lukas Rippitsch Managing HR Consultant As a Managing HR Consultant, Lukas aims to help his team to constantly outperform stakeholder expectations with a clear focus on making processes more efficient and to guarantee client satisfaction. Having started his career in the investment banking sector, Lukas discovered his passion for combining big chunks of data, econometrics and his social skills to solve complex solutions. A set of forensic skills, translation skills (software engineering team vs. normal people) and a good sense of diplomacy are the pillars of this professional career. While working with data throughout his career – from investment banking (RCB), data analysis (Google) and growth hacking & people management (Improove) – he always followed a simple rule (Winston S. Churchill) – “I only believe in statistics that I doctored myself” – pointing out that working with data can be as creative as painting a portrait. As he is known for his consistent good mood and his high energy level, he thrives in a fast-paced digital environment as well as in his local climbing gym. Cooking, wine, wine again and lots of sports are the basis of his personal life. You will always find him looking for an excuse to move your regular Jour Fixe outdoor or trying to convince you to go for a quick 10k run with him instead of your weekly 1:1.

wp:santiago_corredoira-jack_speedinvest.title: Santiago Corredoira-Jack
wp:santiago_corredoira-jack_speedinvest.text: Back to overview Santiago Corredoira-Jack US Managing Director Santiago is a seasoned European entrepreneur in Silicon Valley, where he co-founded 10darts, a communications platform as-a-sevice (CPaaS), and Onpublico, a citizen journalism community leader in local news in the US hispanic market. His experience in startups and network in the Valley made the Spanish Government choose him to set up their startups incubator in San Francisco. Prior to that, Santiago joined the most successful Spanish startup created in the 2000’s, Lanetro – Zed, taking it from scratch to a pre-IPO status within 9 years. Santiago was one of the four C-class team members that took it from a non-revenue status to generating $500m in yearly revenue, managing 150m users worldwide and having operations in 14 countries. In this company, he set up and launched several new business divisions, including the Global Business Development and the Strategic Partnerships and Alliances, managed the operations in the UK, the largest market, and headed the legal department. “In a startup, you never know where the path to success will come from, but you always need to remember that the longer you keep the office light on, the more chances you have of finding it.” Santiago graduated from law school in Madrid and holds 2 masters degrees from the University of London (LLM) and the IESE Business School (Global Executive MBA). He has enjoyed pitching top-notch Sand Hill Road VCs (including Sequoia, Greylock and Andreessen Horowitz) and has also suffered the vertigo of not having enough cash for the payroll 2 weeks before it is due. A strategic thinker and thoroughly data-driven, Santiago is resilient, very curious, an outstanding communicator, skilled negotiator and trusted advisor. He has been collaborating with Students Rising Above for the last 5 years, where he mentors high school seniors with challenging social conditions and outstanding personal and academic potential. Coming from a large family with 7 siblings, the usual startup chaos makes him feel truly at home and comprehensively challenged.

wp:dean-mihajlovic.title: Dean Mihajlovic
wp:dean-mihajlovic.text: Back to overview Dean Mihajlovic Finance Assistant Dean’s interests meet at the intersection of coding and business, whilst cultivating a communicational and creative spirit. After completing his undergrad business studies in Bosnia and Herzegovina, he started to work as a supervisor for the beverage company Vitinka. Diving deeper into distribution and sales, Dean then gained experience as a station handler at FedEx. In 2017, his growing interest in coding motivated him to study business informatics at Vienna University. At Speedinvest, Dean discovered new challenges to apply his analytical and multidisciplinary thinking. Curious about VCs and the startup environment, Dean supports the finance and accounting team and engages in planning and organisation. In his free time, Dean enjoys sports, reading, biking and hiking in the mountains. He also has a passion for craftsmanship.

wp:ranka-teodorovic-milasin.title: Ranka Teodorovic Milasin
wp:ranka-teodorovic-milasin.text: Back to overview Ranka Teodorovic Milasin Office Manager Ranka grew up in Bosnia and Herzegovina. After finishing her Law studies, she was searching for a new challenge and decided to move to Austria. Driven by her international spirit, Ranka did a Master’s in EU Project Management. She gained experience in non-profit administration and project management and worked for NGOs in both Bosnia and Austria. Ranka lives by the rule that no one is born an expert. She is convinced that with a feel for setting priorities, as well as discipline and a well-organized mind, everything can be attained. “The road to change begins at the end of the comfort zone.” Eager to learn day by day, but also to enjoy life, Ranka is in love with rock music and tries to attend as many concerts as she can. She is also a fan of outdoor sports and sudoku puzzles.

wp:konstantin-schmeisser.title: Konstantin Schmeisser
wp:konstantin-schmeisser.text: Back to overview Konstantin Schmeisser Analyst Konstantin strives to challenge the status quo and take innovative entrepreneurial ideas to the next level. He gained profound experience in high-growth insurtech & deep technology ventures, as well as venture capital. Prior to joining Speedinvest x, Konstantin was the first business employee at Targomo, a spin-off from the Hasso-Plattner-Institute, where he was responsible for global expansion, restructuring payment and customer support systems, as well as financial reporting, planning and billing. He holds a Finance Major in International Business from Maastricht University. During his studies, Konstantin co-founded Younico, a platform promoting innovation and skill enhancement for students, as well as entrepreneurship for local growth. Apart from his entrepreneurial activities, Konstantin is an avid cook, skier, reader and golfer, who loves to expand his unrestrained curiosity. Building on his communication and team player skills, he also currently works as a Senior Operations Manager for The Marketplace Conference.

wp:dominik-tobschall.title: Dominik Tobschall
wp:dominik-tobschall.text: Back to overview Dominik Tobschall Principal Dominik is a software developer and lawyer with many years of experience in software development, product management and business development. He has been active in the IT industry since 1998. Before joining Speedinvest, he was a member of the investment team at Target Partners, a leading early-stage tech VC. From 2015 to 2016 he worked on digital projects and took care of technology investments & acquisitions with a member of the executive board at C.H.BECK, one of the major legal publishers in the DACH region. In 2010 he co-founded fruux GmbH, the German software company behind the sabre/dav open source technology, powering sync functionality in popular products, such as atmail, Box, Nextcloud, Posteo, ownCloud and many others. Before that, he worked in various software development and product management roles. Dominik studied law with a focus on taxation at the University of Münster and was admitted to the bar in 2012.

wp:maria-baumgartner.title: Maria Baumgartner
wp:maria-baumgartner.text: Back to overview Maria Baumgartner Managing HR Consultant Maria’s diverse and successful professional history has one common denominator: a desire to truly get to know people. From a startup founder and young political activist to her current role as Managing HR Consultant at Speedinvest, a true passion for people has driven Maria throughout her career. “The moment when you connect with another person and challenge her towards a new set of possibilities is what I love the most!” This passion, honed through many years of leadership experience and further education (Master’s Degree in Mediation) is a crucial asset for Speedinvest. Building out our network of talent and quickly matching candidates with the right opportunity across Speedinvest portfolio companies is where Maria excels like no one else. Before shifting her focus to human resources, Maria was the general manager of one of Austria’s first big dot.com success stories – Datenwerk/Blue-C. While there, she helped grow the company into an agency group with more than 200 employees across Europe and an IPO at the “Neue Markt.” After selling her stake in the company (before the bust), Maria continued her entrepreneurial path by managing a research think tank on Artificial Intelligence (long before the hype), spending time in Silicon Valley and, eventually, helping to found Speedinvest as the first business angel fund in Austria. Maria’s continued appetite to rethink old business sectors and to build healthy companies continues today. Her philosophy: great companies are always built on exceptional talent.

wp:christopher-ewert.title: Christopher Ewert
wp:christopher-ewert.text: Back to overview Christopher Ewert Digital Strategist Chris has broad experiences in digital strategy working for multinational brands such as Heineken and Hutchison Drei Austria in well-respected agencies. Currently he’s a growth marketing specialist with a focus on customer journey design, data-driven marketing and automation. His professional experience is supplemented by a MSc from Erasmus University Rotterdam and a great passion for all things digital.

wp:julia-weinmayr.title: Julia Weinmayr
wp:julia-weinmayr.text: Back to overview Julia Weinmayr Digital Project Manager After stints at Microsoft Austria and CON.ECT, Julia joined Speedinvest in March 2019. With her MSc from WU Vienna she has an analytical mind and can jump into any topic quickly, researching thoroughly until the last insight is unearthed. Julia is organized and handles any project with discipline.

wp:dieter-rappold.title: Dieter Rappold
wp:dieter-rappold.text: Back to overview Dieter Rappold Managing Growth Strategist It was in 1997 as a freshman at the Vienna University of Economics and Business in a lecture when Dieter fell in love with Joseph Alois Schumpeter and the idea of creative destruction and entrepreneurship. After a scholarship at the Graduate School of Management in Irvine in 2000 he founded his first company knallgrau, a leading digital agency, in 2001. The company became a market leader for Blogs and Wiki software which lead to a customer portfolio of renowned companies like as Axel Springer, Swisscom, BMW and many more. In 2009 his founding partners exited the company and Dieter merged with german Virtual Identity AG, acting as part of the management board and leading the Vienna Office until 2017. With combined +180 employees and +22m in turnover he built a leading independent digital agency of the DACH region and exited the company in 2018. Since 2010 Dieter holds several lectures at international Universities for topics like as Social Media, Content Strategy, Digital Marketing and was booked for well over 70 keynotes in the field. “As an Entrepreneur I know the ups and downs, the blood, sweat and tears – and I admire that Founders create something out of nothing. Supporting passionate Founders in their ambitions and helping them grow their idea into worldclass companies is one of the most rewarding things I can think of.“ His never ending admiration for entrepreneurship led Dieter to 6 Angel Investments since 2015. Convinced of the enormous entrepreneurial potential in Europe he believes in market centricity as the major lever to close the existing valuation gap. As part of Speedinvest’s growth marketing team, Dieter is building the leading European platform for the best founders to help them build world-class companies. Today, Dieter supports Startups along their growth path in topics like as branding and positioning, pricing strategies, content strategy and Go-to-market Strategies. As a former 3 time national champion in Handball he is passionate for competition, performance and challenge. Almost as big as his appetite for growth is his appetite for delicious food what sometimes can be annoying in his Instagram feed.

wp:nele-weyens.title: Nele Weyens
wp:nele-weyens.text: Back to overview Nele Weyens HR Consultant Nele joined Speedinvest in February 2020 and is happy to help start-ups in their recruiting activities. Previously, she gained work experience in an agency, Randstad Sourceright, covering EMEA and as an Internal Recruiter at Danone for Eastern Europe. The combination of a Master degree in Clinical and Health Psychology, curiosity for different cultures and a positive attitude, is what makes her passionate about recruitment in an international market. If you want to know more, Nele is always happy to have a chat over a cup of tea!

wp:benedict-stacke.title: Benedict Stacke
wp:benedict-stacke.text: Back to overview Benedict Stacke Senior HR Consultant Benedict joined Speedinvest as Senior HR Consultant in November 2019. With his learnings from startups (wikifolio), corporations (GVC Group) and consulting agencies (ISG), Benedict can advise startups in multiple stages about finding the right talents, developing them and creating effective HR processes. Benedict studied Business Psychology in Austria & UK, attended several further qualifications around strategic talent acquisition, leadership & HR management. Fun Fact: He has a Viennese accent but was born in Berlin and is of Portuguese ancestry.

wp:simon-neugebauer.title: Simon Neugebauer
wp:simon-neugebauer.text: Back to overview Simon Neugebauer HR Consultant Simon is all about high performing teams and ideas. The former originates from his time as a player agent, where he consulted professional footballers and coaches, while also scouting the best young talents. Thereby always wearing the scientific glasses which he had acquired during his Psychology studies in Vienna. After a short interlude at a Innovation Consulting firm, Simon started as a HR Consultant at Speedinvest, where he now focuses on project management, especially for grant applications where he especially loves the ideation part. Simon is always eager to talk about ideas and generally very open minded – unless it’s about the serious matter of food. In his free time, Simon loves to go surfing, and of course, play football.

wp:david-muhr.title: David Muhr
wp:david-muhr.text: Back to overview David Muhr Digital Project Manager David is an experienced Project and Account Manager, formerly working at Vice/Virtue (Austria). He worked as client service lead with multinational companies such as BMW, Coca-Cola, Lexus successfully helping them find an edge among their competition. His experience gives him a strong background in Content Marketing and Operations, meaning he is the guy that brings project on the road and makes sure that there are no lose ends. He also traveled the world and has endless good stories to tell. Ask him about his tattoo!

wp:shiraz-mahfoudhi.title: Shiraz Mahfoudhi
wp:shiraz-mahfoudhi.text: Back to overview Shiraz Mahfoudhi Associate A graduate of ESCP Europe, Shiraz studied in Paris, London and Buenos Aires. She started her career as a Private Equity analyst before joining an equity-crowdfunding startup in Paris where she headed a team of 5 financial analysts. She then joined Malt, a freelancer platform, as Country Launcher and was in charge for the launch of the company in Spain and Germany. Shiraz is based in Paris and will be on the ground growing our presence across France.

wp:alvaro-perezcano.title: Alvaro Perezcano
wp:alvaro-perezcano.text: Back to overview Alvaro Perezcano Analyst A chemical engineer by trade, Alvaro first got exposed to the wonders of venture capital and entrepreneurship during his exchange semester at Harvard. Upon his return to his hometown of Mexico City, he co-founded an Edtech startup designed to connect tutors and coaches with eager-to-learn people. As if founding a company while studying wasn’t enough, he also taught math and chemistry at his local highschool. After finishing his bachelors degree, Alvaro continued to teach in the mornings while working as a finance and business intelligence analyst at an online education startup. As he grew more and more interested in all things finance, he moved to Vienna and joined the Speedinvest Fintech team. If Alvaro is not cooking up a new crazy meal with friends, you can probably find him at the tennis court or doing burpees at the local crossfit gym.

wp:rick-hao.title: Rick Hao
wp:rick-hao.text: Back to overview Rick Hao Principal Rick is driven by intelligent software that leverages machines with data to augment human intelligence. Being part of Speedinvest’s Deep Tech team, Rick invests in startups that are using deep technologies, such as machine learning, to solve big and practical problems with technically ambitious solutions. He believes technology can help address some of the world’s largest problems, from healthcare, mobility, robotics and automation. He looks for entrepreneurs that can gather unique data, deliver smart softwares, and create compounding value for customers. Before joining Speedinvest, Rick was an investor at IQ Capital, a Cambridge based leading deep tech VC. There he sourced and led the firm’s investments in early stage technology companies including causaLens, TurinTech, Pangaea Data and several other deep tech early stage investments. Prior to VC, Rick was a software engineer in the financial industry where he developed advanced payments technology. Rick holds an MSc in Computer Science with Distinction from University of Edinburgh, graduating at the top of his cohort, and an MBA from Imperial College London.

wp:daniela-caserotto-leibert.title: Daniela Caserotto-Leibert
wp:daniela-caserotto-leibert.text: Back to overview Daniela Caserotto-Leibert Head of Business Development, US Daniela has lived and worked in both Europe and the US for many years. In that time, she has gained extensive experience in technology and international business development, operations and strategic sales. As head of Business Development for the US, Daniela now advises European companies in expanding to the US market and connecting them to the broader Silicon Valley ecosystem. “For startups, the right partnership can make all the difference, especially when it comes to distribution. I am passionate about working with entrepreneurs, specifically helping them to connect with potential partners here in Silicon Valley that can accelerate their growth.” Daniela has guided the regulation of digital products, cooperating with governments, lobbying groups, private and state-owned companies in Europe. In Silicon Valley, she made a significant contribution to the go-to-market strategy for the Kleiner Perkins backed company Area1 Security, which protects enterprises from phishing. She also led a major business unit and closed the first 40+ deals. As a mentor for HenkelX, she contributed to Henkel’s entrepreneurial transformation. Daniela is a mentor at the German Accelerator Silicon Valley, helping emerging and established German tech startups to succeed in the US, with tasks comprising US market entry, fundraising, go-to-market strategy, and enterprise sales.

wp:leonard-schmid.title: Leonard Schmid
wp:leonard-schmid.text: Back to overview Leonard Schmid Associate Leo is part of the Industrial Tech invest team and is based in our Munich Office. Fascinated by engineering from an early age, an interest in economics quickly came into the mix when he was introduced to capital markets. After working with BMW in Beijing, he traded in his sleep for Excel-models during an investment banking gig in automotive M&A. Ultimately jumping into the venture industry, Leo experienced the intense period of an early-stage Industrial-IoT startup first-hand, supporting funding efforts and building business development processes from the ground up. With studying stints in Germany and California, Leo holds an M.Sc from RWTH Aachen University. If Leo is not enjoying electronic music on the weekends, you will probably find him sketching out his next kite surfing trip or practicing Muay Thai at his local gym. Being a certified safari-guide after spending months in the African bush, you can certainly count on him having your back should things ever get rough.

wp:linna-morgan.title: Linna Morgan
wp:linna-morgan.text: Back to overview Linna Morgan HR Research Linna joined Speedinvest in mid-October 2019. Always eager to learn she worked in different positions while studying, broadening her horizon and trying to figure out her true passion. On her journey she discovered HR & Recruiting for herself. Prior to joining Speedinvest, she worked as a recruiter in a fundraising agency, managing a team of three people. While gaining valuable work experience she is finishing her bachelor’s degree in Communications. In her free time Linna enjoys going to the gym, meditation, doing illustrations & designs as well as adding to her extensive book collection.

wp:jon-butterfield.title: Jon Butterfield
wp:jon-butterfield.text: Back to overview Jon Butterfield Head of Growth Jon Butterfield’s love for building things has led him to be a serial founder who has started companies across Europe and the United States over the last 15+ years. His extensive knowledge on how to start a business and successfully take it to market has positioned him as one of the thought leaders in growth within Europe. “Growth is all about retaining and engaging your users while using data to tell your story.” He specializes in go-to-market strategies, product-market fit, developing growth models and aligning data and analytics to a business’ and customer goals. He is also an active startup mentor and angel investor. When not building businesses, strategies and models, he spends time on his second passion, building motorbikes. wp:nicole-pereira-gurnell.title: Nicole Pereira-Gurnell
wp:nicole-pereira-gurnell.text: Back to overview Nicole Pereira-Gurnell Head of Community With close to 10 years of product, event, and team management under her belt, Nicole is used to wearing multiple hats, and cool ones at that. She has gained a deep understanding of what makes tech communities thrive and events rock. A fierce believer that everyone has something to bring to the table, Nicole revels in connecting people and discovering their stories. In her role as Head of Community, she fosters knowledge-sharing and meaningful exchange between the founders within the Speedinvest portfolio and beyond. “When you learn from one another, that’s where the magic happens.” Prior to joining the Speedinvest family, Nicole was part of the Skills Matter management team in London. While there, she worked hand-in-hand with the tech community, and led a talented team to curate their vast catalog of events and content products spanning 14+ specialist technology interest areas. She cultivated connections with over 800 experts and encouraged a community-driven strategy that ensured relevant content and a collaborative environment for 160,000 community members. She also spearheaded the launch of several key event brands and the company’s expansion into the US. Before delving into the heartbeat of the tech scene, Nicole was in her home city of Singapore, managing the Corporate Access desk for the Southeast Asian region for two international financial institutions and brought together hundreds of corporate companies and institutional investors. Outside of work, you’ll either find her catching rays on the beach with a copy of Harry Potter or enjoying a good cocktail and some dim sum with her favorite humans.

wp:julian-blessin.title: Julian Blessin
wp:julian-blessin.text: Back to overview Julian Blessin Partner, Network Effects Julian moved from portfolio to partner, joining the Speedinvest team from one of its companies, TIER Mobility, a successful, multinational urban mobility firm he co-founded alongside CEO Lawrence Leuschner and CTO Matthias Laug. Examples of startups launched during his time there include COUP Mobility and NIST. “I love the very early stage of building a company. When everything is coming together, it’s both exciting and scary. The Speedinvest team was instrumental in supporting us at TIER from day one, and I’m looking forward to paying their support forward and giving back to a new generation of founders.” Always a learner, aside from his PhD, Julian extensively studied Business Management and Technology Management not only at LMU, but also at the Center for Digital Technologies and Management, and the University of California Berkeley.

wp:rafael-quintanilla-loeillet.title: Rafael Quintanilla Loeillet
